english: The graph of $y=|x|$ is translated $10$ units in the positive direction of the $x$-axis, the resulting graph is reflected in the $x$-axis, and the graph so obtained is translated $6$ units in the positive direction of the $y$-axis. Let $y=f(x)$, $x\in\mathbb{R}$, be the equation of the final graph, and let $g:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined by $g(x)=\left|f(|x|)\right|$. Then the area of the region $\{(x,y)\in\mathbb{R}^{2}:\ g(x)\leq y\leq6\}$ is ______.
hindi: वक्र $y=|x|$ के आलेख को $x$-अक्ष की धनात्मक दिशा में $10$ इकाई स्थानान्तरित किया जाता है, प्राप्त आलेख का $x$-अक्ष में परावर्तन किया जाता है, तथा इस प्रकार प्राप्त आलेख को $y$-अक्ष की धनात्मक दिशा में $6$ इकाई स्थानान्तरित किया जाता है। माना अन्तिम आलेख का समीकरण $y=f(x)$, $x\in\mathbb{R}$ है, तथा $g:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, $g(x)=\left|f(|x|)\right|$ द्वारा परिभाषित है। तब क्षेत्र $\{(x,y)\in\mathbb{R}^{2}:\ g(x)\leq y\leq6\}$ का क्षेत्रफल ______ है।
solution: $g$ is even ($f(|x|)$ uses $|x|$), so find the area for $x\geq0$ and double it
$g\leq6$ needs $x\leq22$; the region for $x\geq0$ is between $y=g(x)$ and $y=6$ on $[0,22]$
solution_full: Translating $y=|x|$ by $10$ units right gives $y=|x-10|$; reflecting in the $x$-axis gives $y=-|x-10|$; translating $6$ units up gives $f(x)=6-|x-10|$.
$f(|x|)$ depends only on $|x|$, so $g(x)=|f(|x|)|$ is even and its graph is symmetric about the $y$-axis. It is enough to work with $x\geq0$, where $g(x)=|f(x)|$, and double the area.

For $x\geq0$: $f(x)=6-|x-10|$ is $x-4$ on $[0,10]$ and $16-x$ on $[10,\infty)$. It is negative on $[0,4)$, zero at $x=4$ and $x=16$, positive in between with maximum $6$ at $x=10$, and negative for $x>16$.
Taking the modulus: $g(x)=4-x$ on $[0,4]$, $g(x)=6-|x-10|$ on $[4,16]$, and $g(x)=x-16$ on $[16,\infty)$.

The condition $g(x)\leq6$ holds on $[0,22]$ ($g(0)=4$, $g\leq6$ on $[4,16]$ with equality only at $x=10$, and $x-16\leq6\iff x\leq22$). So for $x\geq0$ the region is $\{0\leq x\leq22,\ g(x)\leq y\leq6\}$.
These are $\displaystyle\int_0^4(2+x)\,dx=8+8=16$, $\displaystyle\int_4^{16}|x-10|\,dx=18+18=36$ and $\displaystyle\int_{16}^{22}(22-x)\,dx=18$, a total of $70$.
By symmetry the required area is $2\times70=140$.
originality_note: New: the function is built from y = |x| by an ordered chain of transformations, then both f(|x|) and the outer modulus act on it, and the answer is the area between the resulting W-shaped graph and the line through its peaks (way 5). Closest known: drawing ||x| - a| - b type graphs. Different because: the region touches y = 6 at x = +-10 and is cut off at x = +-22 by the reflected outer arms, so each piece of the graph must be located.

concept_use.Graph transformations: translation, stre: Translation by 10, reflection in the x-axis and translation by 6 turn y = |x| into f(x) = 6 - |x - 10|.
concept_use.Graphs of |f(x)|, f(|x|), |f(|x|)| and m: g = |f(|x|)| is even (from f(|x|)) and the outer modulus reflects the negative parts on [0,4) and (16, infinity), which fixes the region and its area.

stem_review: Read as a student: the order of transformations is explicit, f and g are defined with domain R, the region is given as a set so it has one reading and is bounded (|x| <= 22); answer 140 recomputed exactly with sympy and by a numerical integral; matches the plan 'positive 3-digit integer'. Changed: No change.
key_step: Build f = 6 - |x - 10|, use the evenness of f(|x|) and reflect the negative parts to locate the region on [0, 22].
justification: A routine chain of graph operations followed by areas of triangles; every step is standard and nothing needs insight. Comparable to 2025-P2-Q2 (L2), a routine area of a region between curves.
